rules.statement: Isolate tenants logically inside the single shared database, using the ambient-tenant query filter and ordinary foreign keys; do not add per-tenant databases, per-tenant connection routing, or a control-plane/tenant-plane connection split.
rules.why: Physical isolation is handled by deploying a separate server instance. Putting database-level isolation inside one deployment would need a bootstrap/registry split, cross-database reads and a routing seam, which is a lot of complexity for no gain.
rules.check: Look for code that picks a connection string or DbContext per tenant, adds a tenant-to-database registry or a second control-plane context, or swaps tenant-related foreign keys for loose cross-database identifiers.
